parties: KPI Green Energy Limited; Raz Holding Group
headline: KPI Green Energy and Raz Holding Group sign Non-Binding Letter of Intent for Strategic Investment and/or Collaboration
sum: KPI Green Energy and Raz Holding Group have signed a non-binding Letter of Intent for a proposed strategic investment and/or collaboration. The parties have not disclosed valuation, deal structure or timelines; the LOI is exploratory in nature.
implication: Non-binding LOI signals potential institutional/foreign capital interest in renewable energy infrastructure; partners should monitor for binding definitive agreement triggers, regulatory approvals (FDI/FIPB if foreign capital) and disclosure requirements under Listing Rules.
detail: KPI Green Energy Limited, a listed renewable energy company, and Raz Holding Group have executed a non-binding Letter of Intent dated 24 August 2026 to explore strategic investment and/or collaboration opportunities. No consideration amount, equity stake, timeline or definitive terms have been disclosed. The LOI is preliminary and does not constitute a binding commitment; a definitive agreement would be subject to due diligence, board approvals, shareholder consent (if material) and regulatory clearances.
